America, 1867; 2nd class clk., 30th Sept., 1st class clk., July, 1879; and priv. sec. to Mr. Knatchbull-Hugessen(now Lord Brabourne).M.P., 9th Oct., 1872; called to the bar (Inner Tem.), 18th Nov., 1872; priv. sec. to Mr. James Lowther, M.P., under sec. of state for the cols., 25th Feb., 1874, to 14th Feb., 1878; priv. sec. to the Right Hon. James Lowther, M.P., ch. sec. for Ireland, 15th Feb., 1878; capt. in the E. Lothian yeomanry cavalry, 5th June, 1878; major, 18th June, 1883; hon. lieut.col. and comdg. regt., 1894; comdg. 12th yeomanry brigade, 1895; author of "Mr. Montenello: a Romance of the Civil Service"; priv. sec. to Mr. Stanhope, 3rd Aug., 1886; and to Sir H. Holland (now Lord Knutsford), Jan., 1887, to Aug., 1892; sec. to col. confce., 1887; prim. clk., 1st Jan., 1894; ch. clk., Mar., 1896; ret., Jan., 1909; apptd. off. of arms of the Order of St. Michael and St. George, 1901.

HAMLEY, WILLIAM WYMOND, M.A., F.R.M.S.—Clare Coll., Camb. (hon. classics, 1873); 1st class prof., Roy. Coll., Mauritius, Jan., 1879; sen. prof., May, 1887; ag. rector, May, 1891, to July, 1892, and Apr. to Nov., 1894, again May, 1900; rector, 1901; ag. director of pub. instr. in 19 2, 1963 and 19 4.

HANCOCK, HERBERT HENRY, M.A.—Scholar St. John's Coll., Oxon; 2nd class classical mods., 1876; 2nd class classical finals, 1878; B.A., 1879; M.A., 1883; asst. master Cheltenham Coll., 1879; 2nd master Bosworth schl., 1880; prof. classics and moral philos., Codrington Coll., Barbados, 1883; ag. prin., 1889-91; 2nd master, Queen's Roy. Coll., Trinidad, 1882; ag. prin., Apr. to Dec., 1894, June to Aug., 1898, Sept. to Dec., 1902, and Jan. to Dec., 1908.

HANCOCK, WM. JOHN, M. Inst. C.E., M.I.E.E.—B. 1865; hon. loc. sec., I.E.E., Lond.; ed. at Univ. of Glasgow; supt. of telephones, W. Aust., 1885; supt. of telegraphs, 1890; govt. electrical engr., 1894.

HAND, JOHN ST. VINCENT.—1st cls. clk., col. sec.'s off., Lagos, Oct., 1898; ch. clk., gen. man.'s off., Lagos govt. rlyw., Apr., 1901; astl. sec., sec.'s off., S. Nigeria, Feb., 1904; priv. sec. to J. J. Thorburn, Esq., ag. gov. of Lagos, July, 1905; and clk. to exec. coun.

HANDS, ARTHUR L.C.—B. 1880; clk. in P.O., St. Helena, Sept., 1896; 2nd clk., col. sec.'s off., Apr., 1898; ch. clk. and clk. to exec. coun., Jan., 1907.

HANITSCH, KARL RICHARD, PH.D. (Jena).—B. 1860; demonstrator of Zoology, Univ. Coll., Liverpool, 1887; curator and librarian, Raffles library and museum, Singapore, 1895.

HANLEY, ALLAN HASTINGS, C.M.G. (1903); F.R.C.S.—Med. offr., Niger Coast Prot. (now S. Nigeria), May, 1893; sen. med. offr., Apr., 1901; dep. prin. med. offr., May, 1903; ag. prin. med. offr., Dec., 1903 to Apr., 1904.

HANN, HUGH.—B. 1862; joined R.A. 1881; served in India, 1882 to 1890; ret. from serv., 1890; joined home prison serv., 1891; promoted clk. and schoolmaster, 1896; supt. of pris., S. Leone, 1891; sheriff and ag. supt. of pol., S. Leone, July to Sept., 1902; J.P. for colony, 1902; formed S. Leone fire brigade and first supt., 1893; introduced identification by finger impressions, 1905; 1st astl. supt. of pris., Ceylon, 1906; supt. of pris., Kandy, 1st Nov., 1906.

HANNAY, HENRY DESMOND.—Sub-inspr., Bechuanaaland Prot. police, 1901; ag. mag., N'Gami, 1907-08.

HANNYNGTON, JOHN ARTHUR.—Capt., Indian army; temp. maj., King's African Rifles; ed. at Unit. Serv. Coll., Westward Ho!; passed in Hindustani, higher standard, Pashtu, higher standard, Kiswahili, govt. test. exam. for promotion to field offr. and staff employ; gazetted 8th June, 1889; apptd. comdt., Jubaland Camel Corps, 15th Dec., 1901; comdt., 6th King's African Rifles, Somaliland Prot., 28th Feb., 1905.

HARAN, JAMES AUGUSTINE.—Med. offr., E. Africa Prot., 1st Feb., 1898.

HARBIN, JOHN ALPHONSO.—Ch.clk. to regisr., Grenada, July, 1884; ditto to regisr. sup. ct., July, 1886; marshal V.-A. ct., Mar., 1887; ag.
register, sup. ct., and ag. registrar, in V.-A. ct., May, 1888, to Apr., 1890; acctnt., treasury, July, 1890; sec. to commn. pub. wks. dept. inquiry, Dec., 1890; ag. ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, Aug., 1892, to Feb., 1893; ag. inspr. of schools Feb., 1893, to Mar., 1894; inspr. of schools Mar., 1894; ag. col. postmaster, Aug., Sept., 1894; mem. bd. of ed., Apr., 1895; ag. registrar, sup. ct., Aug., Sept., 1901; ag. inspr. of schools, St. Vincent, Sept.-Nov., 1901; mem. bd. of ed., St. Vincent, Sept.-Nov., 1901; ag. pol. mag. and asst. treas., Carriacou, Dec., 1901, to Jan., 1902.

HARBOUR, E. W. H.—B. 1881; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to bd. of trade, 22nd Jan., 1901; transf'd to C.O., 22nd July, 1901.

HARBY, F. N.—B. 1888; apptd. after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to C.O., 1st May, 1906.

HARCOURT, ALGERNON BERNARD.—B. 1863; apptd. cons. agnt. in Oil R. Protect., Oct., 1892; ag. v.-cons., Bonny dist., June, 1894, to July, 1895; dist. comsnr., Bonny, 1st Apr., 1896; ag. v.-cons. cent. div. on various occasions; transfrd. to Cross Riv. div., Dec., 1896; travelling comsnr., S. Nig., 1st Apr., 1900; ag. divsl. comsnr., Cross Riv. div., May-Dec., 1900; ag. res., Benin City Territories, 1901 and 1902; dist. comsnr., Cross River, 17th Jan., 1903; polit. offr., M'Kpani expdn., 1903 (medal and clasp); ag. sec. and dep. high comsnr., 24th Feb. to 3rd Apr., 1905; asst. prov. comsnr., E. Prov., 1st May, 1906; ag. prov. comsnr., E. Prov., June to Dec., 1906; ditto, W. Prov., 1st Jan. to 31st Mar., 1907.

HARDING, ALFRED J.—B. 1878; ed. Christ's Coll., Brecon, and St. John's, Camb.; foundtn. schlr., 1899; 1st class nat. sci. trip, part I., 1900; B.A., 1900; ent. C.O. after compet. exam. as 2nd. cl. clk., Oct., 1901; sec. to comteet. to inquire into organisation of crown agents' office, 1908.

HARDING, EDWARD J., M.A. (1907).—B. 1880; ed. Dulwich Coll. and Hertford Coll., Oxford (scholar, 1899); 1st cls. class. mods., 1901; 2nd cls. lit. hum., 1903; B.A., 1903; apptd. after compet. exam., 2nd cls. clk., marine dept., bd. of trade, 30th Nov., 1903; 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 31st May, 1904.

HARDY, WENTWORTH MARMADUKE.—Entered survey dept., S. Australia, Oct., 1865; accompanied the survr.-gen. as survr. and draughtsman to Port Darwin, Dec., 1868; rose step by step, till apptd. Jan., 1878, trigonometrical survr. In 1884, at the recommendation of the survr.-gen. of Victoria, and to carry out his suggested reformation, appointed inspr. of surveys and prof. adviser, survey dept., Tasmania.

HARE, FREDERICK ARTHUR.—Ed. St. Columba's Coll., Wicklow; clk. to agts., Vasse, W. Australia, 1889; clk. and asst. priv. sec. to Sir William Robinson, during various periods from 1880 to 1882; inspr. of pol. for the S. dists. of the col., 1882; priv. sec. and A.D.C. to Sir F. N. Broome; ag. govt. res., Wyndham, Cambridge Gulf, 1886-7; ag. govt. res., Albany, 1887-8; res. mag. York, 1888-97; warden and res. mag. East Coolgardie Goldfield, 1897-1900; comsnr. of police, 1900.

HARE, REGINALD CHARLES.—B. 1853; clk. treasury, W. Australia, Apr., 1881; pol. inspr. S. dists., June, 1886; sg. govt. res., Wyndham, May, 1888; ditto, Roebourne, June, 1889; sec. W. Australian govt. agency, London, May, 1891.

HARLAN, WM. HENRY.—Apptd. after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. serv. and assigned to science and art dept., 10th Apr., 1900; and to bd. of agric., 6th June, 1901; transf'd C.O., 27th Jan., 1902.

HARPER, CHARLES HENRY.—Ed. at Blundell'sch., Devon, and Exeter Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1899; passed final exam. for the bar, Oct., cadet, G. Coast, 24th Jan., 1900; attached Ashanti field force, 1st June to 1st Sept., 1st asst. dist. comsnr., 6th Sept., 1901; ag. asst. sec., 26th Oct., 1904; asst. col. sec., 8th Feb., 1906; ag. chief asst. col. sec. and clk. of corps., 14th Apr. to 25th June, 1908; cantonment mas. Comassie, 16th Oct., 1908.

HARPER, FRANCIS HENRY.—B. 1877; transferred from the service of the Royal Niger Co. supplementary clk. to C.O., 1st Jan., 1900.

HARRIOTT, ALEXIS WINNIS.—Ed. at Yale; B.A., 1856; M.A. and B.Ph., 1859; ag. col. serv. and inspr., P.W., Turks and Caicos Islds., Feb. to Apr., 1864; J.P., 1879; unoffl. mem. leg. bd., 1881 to 1888, when apptd. asst. compt. Grand Turk; ag. comsnr., Apr. to July, 1888 manager savings bk., 1889; mem. bd. of econ., 1891; coroner, 1893; ag. auditor on various occasions, 1888-1906; ag. offl. mem. of leg. bd., 1904 and 1905; asst. comsnr., Salt (G.), July, 1907.

HARRIOTT, EDMUND COWLES.—B. 1865; asst. comsnr., and to legis. bd., Turks and Caicos Islds., Nov., 1887; inspected govt. schls., 1890, 1891 and 1902; ag. reglar. sup. ct., and of deeds, 1891 and 1894; ag. asst. comsnr., dist. mag., rec. sup. ct., man. savings bank and inspr. of penal prisons, G. Turk, May to July, 1896, Aug. to Nov., 1901, and May to Aug., 1906; ag. and Aug. and Sept., 1901, and June to Aug., 1906; ag. dist. mag., visiting Caicos Is., July, 1902; acctnt. and clk. (collr. of cust., postmtr., cashiers and regisr. shipping); comsnr.'s office, Apr. to June, 1903; confirmed July, 1903; ag. offl. mem. legis. bd., 1906; 1st cls. clk., rev. dept., Jamaica, Jan., 1907; is a J.P.

HARRIS, CHARLES ALEXANDER, C.B. (1904): C.M.G. (1900): B.A.—B. 1855; scholar, prizeman and Porteus medallist of Christ's Coll., Camb. Tanned student in com. law, Linc.'s Inn, 1877; 12th classic, 1878; apptd. 2nd class clk., C.O., after open competn., 1st July, 1879; sec. to W. Indies Finance Comms., Dec., 1882; asst. sec. Sugar Bounties Confec., 1889; priv. sec. to Mr. Buxton, M.P., Jan., 1894, to June, 1895; and to the Earl of Selborne, June, 1895; 1st class clk., 1896; specially engaged in work connected with Venezuelan bndry. arbitn., 1896-8; priv. clk., Nov., 1898; sent to Paris, 1899, in connection with the Venez. bndry. arbitn.; conducted British case in Brazilian-B. Guiana bndry. arbitn., 1904; mem. of comteet. to inquire into organisation of crown agents' office, 1908; chief clk., Jan., 1909; represents C.O. on advisory comteet. of comm. intell., B. of T.; author of numerous articles in Dict. of Pol. Econ. on economic and statistical subjects, and of lives of various colonial govrs. and statesmen in Dict. of Nat. Biog.

HARRISON, CUTHBERT E.—Apptd. consular agt., Oil Rivers Prot., June, 1891; ag. vice-com. 1892 to 1895; made dist. comsnr., and served through Brass punitive expedition (medal and clasp), 1895; apptd., political offr., Niger colons., Aro Field Force, 1902 (medal and clasp); ag. dir. comsnr., Cross River division, Apr.-Sept., 1904.

HARRISON, CUTHBERT WOODVILLE—B. 1874; ed. at Sherborne Sch., Clifton Coll., Balliol Coll., Oxford, and with Walter Wren Esq.; 3rd cls. class. mods., 1894; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1897; ag. asst. dist. offr., Klang, May,
1899; also ag. harb. mast., Klang, Feb., 1901; passed cadet, Apr., 1901; asst. dist. offr., Ulu Langat, continued also as ag. asst. dist. offr., Klang, and harb. mast. at Port Swettenham, Oct., 1901; ag. dist. offr., Ulu Langat, Dec., 1903; ditto, Tampin, Mar., 1904; also asst. dist. offr., Matang, Oct., 1904; ag. asst. sec. to res., Mar., 1905; ag. sec. to res., Aug., 1906; ag. asst. sec. to res., Dec., 1906.

HARRISON, JAMES HERBERT HUGH.—Ed. Regent's Park Coll., and New College (Lond.), and at University Coll. and Hospital; F.R.C.P. (Lond.); M.R.C.S. (Eng.); dist. mag. and dist. surg., Cavo, Br. Honduras, 1890; ag. dist. surg., Orange Walk, 1891, 1892; dist. comsrr. and dist. surg., Orange Walk, June, 1892; asst. col. surg., Belize, 12th May, 1897; col. surg., 1st Sept., 1906.

HARRISON, JOHN BURCHMORE, C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1856; Nat. Sc. scholar, Christ's Coll., Camb., B.A. (Nat. Sc. Tripos), 1878; M.A., 1887; prof. of chemistry and agricul. science, Barbados, Sept., 1879; govt. analyst and prof. of chem., Br. Guiana, Dec., 1889; director of dept. of science and agric., B. Guiana, Jan., 1905; is F.I.C., F.G.S., F.C.S., and F.G.S. of America; author of numerous papers relating to the agric. and geology of the W. Indies and B. Guiana; on spec. serv. to U.S.A. in connection with questions relating to sugar analysis, recd. thanks of U.S. govt.; specially thanked on several occasions by S. of S. for services in connection with tropical agriculture, etc.

HARRISSON, SYDNEY THIRLWALL, C.M.G. (1908).—Ed. Blackheath; apptd. asst. acct., P.W.D., G. C. Col., 9th Nov., 1894; ch. acct., 2nd June, 1897; asst. acct., W.A.F.F., 26th Feb., 1898; ch. acct., 8th Nov., 1899; treas. N. Nig., 1st Jan., 1900; comptroller of customs, Barbados, 1908.

HART, JOHN HINCHLEY, F.L.S.—Fellow of Malacological and Therap. socs., England; corres. mem. Pharmaceutical soc.; mem. of Roy. Inst. of Pub. Health; supt. King's House, gardens and grounds, Jamaica, during their formation, Nov., 1875; supt., govt. cinchona plantations, Oct., 1881; ag. dir. pub. gardens and plantations, July, 1886; ch. botanical dept., Trinidad, Mar., 1887; editor of Trinidad Bulletin from 1887 to date; is a fellow Linn. Soc.; author of a "Botanist's Ramble in Cent. America," a work on cacao culture, curing, and fermenting (1891), a report on forest conservation (1891), and pamphlets relating to the cultivation of W. Indian products; engaged by the govt. of the Windward Is. to inspect and report on the working of the botanical stations, St. Vincent and Grenada (1890); lieut. Trinidad rifle volrs., Mar., 1889; govt. member, Trinidad public library, 1889; capt., Trinidad rifle volrs., 1897; capt. reserve, 1898; del. for Trinidad at W. Indian agric. conf., 1899 and subsequent years; established seismo-graph statn., Milne's pendulum, 1900; chief inspr. under Plant Protection Law, 1904; comsrr. for Trinidad at C. and I. exhibn., Crystal Palace, 1905; mem. of govt. permanent exhibn. com., 1907; ex. off. mem. agric. soc. Trinidad; supt. botanic station, Tobago; author of several papers on rubber cultivation in West Indies.

HART, WALTER EDWARD.—B. 1847; librarian, public library and museum, Mauritius, 1st Oct., 1903.

HARTE, LOVELACE FRED. EDWARD RALPH.—First class certif. at I.C. Coll. in Dec., 1875; articled law student, 3rd Jan., 1876; ag. clk. of the peace the same year; Jan., 1877, clk. in customs dept., Trinidad; clk. in audit office, Sept., 1878; 7th clk., Jan., 1883, June, 1887; 2nd clk., regis., sup., 1887; ch. clk., 1897; also comsrr. of oaths for whole isld.; ag. dep. regis. on occasions in 1896-7-8.

HARTLEY, CHAS.—M.A., Cantab.; lecturer in English and modern languages, Royal Coll., Ceylon, 11th Dec., 1896; principal, Royal Coll., 23rd June, 1903.

HARTLEY, E. B., C.M.G. (1901).—Surg.-Lieut.-Col., C. M. R.; created V.C. for gallantry in the operations against the stronghold of the Basuto chief Morosi; prin. med. offr., Cape col. forces, 1878; served through the Gaika, Morosi, and Basuto wars, 1878-81; govt. med. offr., Basutoland, 1874-7; ret., 1904.

HARTLEY, JOHN WHITTAM.—Ed. at Owens Coll., Manchester; M.B., Ch.B., Mar., 1904; Kaye Shuttleworth schlr., Victoria Univ., 1898-1901; temp. asst., medical dept., Hong Kong, Aug., 1906; surg.-lieut., Hong Kong vol. corps., Aug., 1907; rly. med. offr., Oct. to Dec., 1906; asst. supt., G.C.H., Dec., 1906, to Oct., 1907; rly. med. offr., Oct., 1907.

HARVEY, GEORGE LEONARD, C.E.—Asst. dir. of wks., So. Nigeria, June, 1900; asst. dir. of pub. wks., 1901; deputy dir. of pub. wks., 1901; ag. dir. of pub. wks., Mar. to Nov., 1902, and Apr. to Nov., 1904.

HARWARD, JOHN.—Principal, Royal Coll., Ceylon, 1st Apr., 1892; dir. of pub. instr., 23rd June, 1903.

HASKINS, WILFRED J., A.M.C.E.A.—Asst. supt. of wks., S. Stltmsts., Mar., 1905.

HASTINGS, W. C. N.—D.S.O. (1902); 2nd lieut., 4th batt. South Wales Bord., 1891; capt., 1895; asst. inspr., S. Leone Frontier Pol., 1898; inspr., 1899; ag. dist. comsrr., Koinadugu dist., 1899; S. Leone expedn., 1898-1899 (medal with clasp); 2nd lieut., Manchester regt., 1899; capt., 1901; S. Africa, 1900-1902 (ment. in desps., two medals and five clasps); lieut., N. Nigeria regt., 1903; captain, 1903; Munshi expedn., 1906; in command of Gambia company, W.A.F.F., 1906.

HATCHER, C. M.—B. 1873; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. 2nd div. civ. ser., and assigned to W.O., 11th Sept., 1893; transf'd to C.O., 18th Mar., 1896; minor staff offr., Feb., 1902.

HATHERTON, BARON.—Col. the Hon. Edward George Percy Littleton, C.M.G. (1880); b. 1842; late mil. sec. to the gov.-gen. of Canada.

HATTON, EDWIN FULLARTON, M.D., M.R.C.S.—Ed. at Upper Canada Coll. and Toronto Univ.; entd. col. serv., 1882; is now med. supt. of lunatic asylum and poor asylum, and dist. med. offr., Grenada; M.L.C.

HAWKINS, ISAAC THOMAS, M.I.C.E.—B. 1858; mem. of incorp. assoc. of mun. and county engrs.; diplomas in engineering science and construction, sanitary science and pub. health law; articled and served through shops, 1875-1881; held two chief mun. appts., 1882-1888, and 1888-1897 (including the designing and carrying out of an extensive scheme of water supply); col. survr., Lagos, 19th June, 1897; dep. dir. of pub. wks., 1st Jan., 1898; prov. engnr., S. Nigeria, 1st May, 1906; ag. D.P.W. for an aggregate period of 4½ years, between 1897 and 1906.

HAWTREY, WILFRED R. J.—Lieut. 2nd batt. Royal Fusiliers; asst. supt. of pol., S. Stltmsts., Oct., 1901; ag. supt. of pol., Singapore, Dec., 1906, to Feb., 1907; ag. supt. of pol., Malacca, Apr., 1908.

HAY, SIR JAMES SHAW, K.C.M.G. (1889), C.M.G. (1887).—B. 1839; joined 89th (Princess Victoria's) regt. in 1858; served in India during the latter part of the Mutiny; was adjt. for some time,
and afterwards instructor of musketry; ag. adjt. to the provisional depot batt. at Dum Dum in 1859; adjt. to the Glasgow Highland volrs. in 1868 at their formation; asst. instr., G. Coast arm. nat. pol., 1875; dist. commr. of Accra, Oct., 1875; instr.-gen., G. Coast constab., Apr., 1877; asst. col. sec., G. Coast col., 1878; had charge of several special missions to the tribes in the interior; ag. col. sec. from Oct., 1878, to Jan., 1880, and again, Aug., 1880; inspr.-gen. of pol., Mauritius; adminstr. of the Gambia, 1885; adminstrd. the govt. of the W. Africa Sttlmts., from July, 1886, to Dec., 1887; gov., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1888; served in the Yonnie expdn., 1887-8 (medal and clasp); ag. admstr., Barbados, 1891; gov., Barbados, 1892 to 1900.

HAYCRAFT, THOS. WAGSTAFFE.—B.A., St. John's Coll., Oxon; called to the bar, In Tem., 1885; practised in S.E. circuit and Sussex sessions; examr. of the ct., 1889 to 1899; apptd. arbitrator on bd. of Lon. cham. of arbitration, 1897; pres. dist. ct., Larnaca, Cyprus, 1899; ag. Queen's advocate, Oct., 1900, to Feb., 1901; author of "Executive Powers in relation to Crime and Disorder."

HAYES-WILLIAMS, WILLIAM JOHN.—B. 1862; regsr.-gen., New South Wales, 1898.

HAYNES, THOS. BENJAMIN.—Apptd. dispenser, penal settlement, Massaruni, B. Guiana, 6th June, 1879; 1st cls. prison warder, 12th July, 1877; schl.mstr. in charge of penal settmtns., 1st Sept., 1878; dispenser in charge of leper asylum, Know Is., 27th Oct., 1879; clk. to penal settmtns., 27th Oct., 1883; keeper, New Amsterdam prison, Berbice, 5th July, 1887; supt., Georgetown prison, 19th June, 1894.

HAYNES, W. LINDSAY H.—Clk. to ch. just., Barbados, 1874-8; clk. to comsrs. apptd. to investigate offences against rioters, 1876; int. rev. offr., dist. B, 1878; now inspr. of int. rev. offrs. registr.

HAYWOOD, CECIL WALTER INGLEFIELD WIGHTWICK.—Ed. in Germany and Belgium; E. Tel. Co., 1895-1900; 3rd astt., Uganda Prot., 15th Apr., 1901; astt. collr., E. Africa Prot., 1st Apr., 1902; collr., 1st Apr., 1905.

HAZELAND, FRANCIS ARTHUR.—B. 1861; clk. to puisne judge, Hong Kong, Nov., 1878; ag. dep. registr., Mar. to Nov., 1882; clk. to ch. just., Sept., 1883; ag. ch. clk. col. sec. office, Mar. to Oct., 1899; ag. clk. of coun., Mar. to Dec., 1899; dep. registr. and acctnt., Jan., 1896; J.P., 1894; ag. registr., sup. cls., offl. trustee, registr. of companies and land offr., Oct., 1895, to Feb., 1896; has passed in Chinese (higher standard); called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, Hilary, 1900; ag. pol. mag., June, 1900, to June, 1901; 2nd pol. mag., 7th June, 1901; ag. 1st pol. mag. and coroner on several occasions, 1902-1907.

HEAN, HON. ALEXANDER.—B. 1859; warden and coun. of Sorrell mun., Tasmania, since 1886; M.L.A. for Sorrell since 1903; min. of lands and wks., agric. and rwy., and coun. of main roads, July, 1904.

HEANLEY, CHAS. MONTAGUE.—M.B., B.S., Lond., M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., D.T.M. and H., Camb., D.P.H., Lon.; prizeman in bacteriology and other subjects, St. George's hosp.; late clin. astt., Paddington infirmary; med. offr., Dagenham smallpox hosp.; med. offr., West Ham Bor., fever hosp.; med. offr. on plague duty in India; 2nd astt. bacteriologist, Mdlsx. hosp.; astt. bacteriologist, Hong Kong, 1906; lecturer in pathology and bacteriology, Hong Kong coll. of med., 1907.

HEARSEY, HERBERT HYDE YOUNG.—Apptd. med. offr., B. Cent. Africa Prot., 6th June, 1896; principal officer, Apr., 1902.

HEATH, W. G.—M.B., Ch.B., Edin. Un. qualified 1897; med. offr., Windward Dominica, 1898; med. offr., dist. 2, Monserat, 1901; ag. med. offr., dist. "D," Dominica, 1901; ditto dist. "A," Dominica, 1904.

HEIDENSTAM, DR. F. C., C.M.G. (Ire.)—Ch. med. offr., Cyprus, 1882.

HEIDENSTAM, OSCAR CHARLES.—B. 1870; ed. at King's Sch., Warwick; vol. clk. col. sec. offr., Cyprus, 5th Feb., 1891; 3rd div. clk., dist. 16th Jan., 1899; inspr. of pol., 12th Jan., sent to Egypt for training with H.M.'s troops in June and July, 1904; in command of depot, Aug., 1904; in command of Kyrena div. gov. prison and dep.coroner, 15th July, 1905; in command of Papho div., gov. of prison and dep. coroner, 4th Aug., 1906; acted as commr. Papho on several occasions; passed in mod. Gov. lower standard, Apr., 1906; ag. priv. sec. A.D.C. to high commr., Sir C. A. King-Harman, and clk. of exec. coun., 4th Jan. to 15th Feb., 1907; temporarily attached to ch. sec. s. 16th Feb., 1907; in cmd. of pol., Kyrena div., gov. of pris., and dep. coroner, 24th June, 1907; asst. dist. astt. of pol., Uganda Prot., 12th July, 1907; in command of Entebbe pol., and succ. cent. gaol, 10th Sept., 1907.

HELLIER, MAURICE.—Mast. of govt. Eng. schls., S. Sttlmts., Dec., 1887; ag. & inspr. of schls., Malacca, Nov., 1904; ag. of Malay Coll., Malacca, Sept., 1905; ag. subj. educn., Penang, May, 1906; ag. inspr. of educn., Singapore and Malacca, Dec., 1906; commr., Jan., 1907; ag. dir. of educn., S. Sttlmts. at F.M.S., Mar. to July, 1908.

HELY-HUTCHINSON, THE HON. STR WAITE FRANCIS, G.C.M.G. (1897), K.C.M.G. (Ire.), C.M.G. (1893).—B.1849; B.A. of Trin. Coll., Camb.; called to the bar by the soc. of the Inner Temp.; accompanied Sir Hercules Robinson to Fiji as special attacheé on the occasion of the cession of the islands to Gt. Britain, in Sept., Oct., 1874, for Fiji affairs; priv. sec. for N.S. Wales affairs, Jan., 1875; col. sec. of Barbados, Nov., 1877; ch. sec. to govt. of Malta, 1883; and dept. gov. and ch. sec. to govt., 1884; gov. of Windward Is., 1889; gov. of Natal, 1893; gov. Cape, 1901.

HEMERY, PERCY.—B. 1851; 1st clk. govt. savings bank, Br. Guiana, July, 1880; 3rd clk. treas., Jan., 1881; cashier, Aug., 1881; ag. clk., 1884 and 1885; acctnt., govt. savings bank, Apr., 1888; ag. col. book-keeper, July, 1888, and Aug., 1890; ag. astt. rec.gen., and ag. sub-admstr., Berbice, Feb., 1891; ag. dep. rec.gen., Apr., 1891; May to Dec., 1892, May, 1893-1894, twice in 1895-8; sec. cattle diseases commn., Oct., 1891; astt. rec.gen., Berbice, June, 1897; J.P., and commr. of oaths and affid., June, 1897; asst. admistr-gen., Berbice, Nov., 1897 (additional); ag. dep. recvr.gen., 1898; ag. compt. of cust., 22nd Feb., 1904; ag. recvr.gen., July, 1906.

HEMSTERD, CHARLES SELWOOD.—3rd treas. astt., E. Africa Prot., 20th Apr., 1900; astt. collr., 1st Apr., 1903; dist. commr., 1st Apr., 1907.

HEMSTERD, RUPERT WILLIAM.—2nd treas. astt., E. Africa Prot., 19th Sept., 1899; cl. acctnt., Somaliland, 1st Dec., 1901, to 1st Dec., 1903; astt. collr., E. Africa Prot., 1st Dec., 1901; collr., 17th Dec., 1906.

HENDERSON, FREDERICK LOUIS.—Ed. at Camb. Univ.; B.A., 1897; M.R.C.S., (Eng.), L.R.C.P., (Lon.).; med. offr., E. Africa and Uganda Prots., 18th Oct., 1904.
HENDERSON, Alexander.—B. 1874; apptd. clk. refugee camps, O.R.C., 1st Nov., 1901; clk. attached to audit dept., Apr. 1902; examnr. of acts., treasy., 20th Aug., 1902; acctnt. dept. of agric., 1st July, 1904.

HENDERSON, J. T.—Shorthand reporter of debates, legis. coun., Natal, 1883.

HENDY, CHARLES LOWICK.—B. 1858; sen. clerical ast. inspr., prisons office, Br. Guiana, 1881; ag. clk. of supplies and sec. to the bd. of prisons, July to Oct., 1885; July to Sept., 1888; and June, 1890, to Jan., 1891; issuer to convict prison, Rio Massaruni, Nov., 1890; clk. of supplies and sec. to bd. of prisons, June, 1892; ag. supt. orphan asyl., Nov. to Dec., 1895, and Feb. to July, 1896; ag. man. dir. orphan asyl., in addition to duties as clk. of supplies, from July to Nov., 1898, May, 1899, to Jan., 1900, Nov. to Dec., 1900; ag. supt. orphan asyl., July, 1901, to Jan., 1903; ag. supt., almshouse, and sec. poor law comsrs., June, 1903, to Apr., 1904; resumed duties as clk. of supplies, prisons dept., Apr., 1904.

HENNESSEY, PATRICK H.—M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.); house surg., S. Sttlmts., Feb., 1907; supernumerary med. offr., Penang, Feb., 1908.

HENSON, STANLEY B.—Police probationer, S. Sttlmts., Dec., 1907.

HENNIKER-HEATON, HERBERT.—B.A. (Oxon.); ed. at Eton and New Coll., Oxford, (hons. hist., 1901); cadet, Fiji, 1902; attached to col. sec.'s off., to 1905; European offr., armed constab., June, 1903; in regisr.-gen.'s off., Mar.-May, 1904; ag. adjut., armed constab., musk. instr., and inspr. of pol., Feb., 1905, to Feb., 1906; stip. mag., Feb., 1906, and ag. stip. mag., Lau, and inspr. of taxes, Feb. to May, 1906; ch. clk., native dept., and ag. ast. native comsrr., July, 1906; apptd. ast. native comsrr., Mar., 1907.

HERBERT, CHAS. ADWARD.—M.H.A., South Australia, 1900-05; govt. res. and judge of N. Territory, 1905.

HERCHENRODER, FURCY ALFRED, K.C.—B. 1865; ed. Roy. Coll., Mauritius; called to bar, Mid. Tem., June, 1888; ag. crown pros., Mauritius, 1893-8; leg. adviser, pol. mag., crown pros., conserv. of mortgages, and curator of vacant estates, Seychelles, May, 1898; judge, Seychelles, 1900; ch. just., 1903; proc. and advoc. gen., Mauritius, 3rd Apr., 1903.

HEREFORD, GEORGE A.—Cadet, S. Sttlmts., Nov., 1898; ag. dist. officer, Balik Pulau, Penang, Apr., 1899; passed final exam. in Malay, Oct., 1901; supt. of educn., Penang, Nov., 1902; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Jan., 1904; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, Mar., 1906; ast. dist. offr., Batu Gajah, Jan., 1907.

HERN, W. STANLEY.—B. 1876; lieut., Duke of Edinburgh's Wiltshire Regt.; served in Mashonaland rebellion, 1896-1897; in S. Africa, 1900-1902; with W.A.F.F., 1904-05; offr. comdg. preventive service, Lagos, 1906; dist. comsrr., June, 1906; offr. comdg. Ijebu Ode, 1906; dist. comsrr., Ikorodu and Sagamu, 1907.

HERVEY, DUDLEY FRANCIS AMELIUS, C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1849; ed. at Marlborough; cadet, S. Sttlmts., May, 1867; passed in Malay in Nov., 1868; ag. priv. sec. to gov. in Mar., 1869; ch. clk. and interp. to the lieut.-gov., Penang, Jan., 1870, in which year he accompanied H.M.S. "Algerine" to inquire into various cases of piracy on the coast of Acheen; sen. sworn clk., sup. ct., Singapore, Jan., 1871, also clk. in bankruptcy, and J.P. and ag. mag., Sept., 1871; Aug., 1878, pol. mag., Malacca; has accompanied various expdsns. to the different native states of the peninsula; J.P.; res. councillor, Malacca, 1882; also supt. of Negri Semblan, 1883-6; ret., Dec., 1893.

HESKETH, GILBERT WOOD.—Ed. Birkenhead, and Caughton, Ches.; engineer, corporation, City of Cape Town engine works; joined service of P.W.D., O.R.C., 2nd July, 1903.

HEWICK, JOHN EDWIN.—Ed. Highgate Schl.; ast. supt. of pol., P.W., 1872; during the Perak war commanded an expdn. across the country in pursuit of Sultan Ismail. Called to the bar of the Mid. Tem., 1880; stip. mag. Br. Guiana, 1883; sheriff of Essequibo, 1884; sheriff of Berbice, 1889; stip. mag. east and west bank, New Amsterdam, 1892; Berbice, 1893; puisne judge, Br. Guiana, 1st Oct., 1900.

HEYWOOD, ARTHUR WM.—B. 1853; ast. to supt. of woods and forests, Cape Col., Jan., 1884; dist. forest offr., 1888; conservator, Knysna, Mar., 1895; ditto, Transkeian Territories, May, 1898; ditto, King Williams Town, July, 1907.

HEYWOOD, JAMES BARNES.—I.S.O. (1905); b. 1840; parly. clk., N. Zealand, 1871; clk., P.W.D., 1871; acctnt., res. min. for Middle Island, 1871; clk., treasy., 1873; acctnt., treasy., 1878; sec. to treasy., recvr.-gen. and paymr.-gen., 1890; ast. contr. and auditor, 1906.

HICKIE, CLARENCE FREDERICK.—Acctnt., Uganda rly., 1st Apr., 1898; ast. ch. acctnt., 1st Nov., 1899; 3rd treasy. ast., E. Africa Prot., 1st May, 1903; 2nd treasy., ast., 28th Nov., 1903.

HICKSON, ROBERT R. PURDON, M.I.C.E.—Res. engrnr., Carlingford harbour wks., Ireland, 1866 to 1872; res. engrnr. Barrow harbour wks., England, 1872-6; engrnr.-in-ch. harbours and jetties, S. Australia, 1876 to 1881; ast. engrnr. harbours and rivers, N.S. Wales, 1881-9; comsrr. and engrnr.-in-ch. roads, bridges, and sewerage, 1889 to 1895; under sec. for pub. wks., and comsrr. for roads, 1896-1901; vice-pres. of pub. wks. tender bd., and chmn. of deptmtl. bd. of reference, N.S.W.; J.P. for S.A. and N.S.W.; pres. of Sydney harbour trust since 1901.

HIGGINS, EVELYN SCOTT.—Ed. at Blundell's Schl., Tiverton, and Chatham House, Ramsgate; served on Uganda rly., 1898-1900; supt. of pol., Somaliland Prot., 22nd May, 1905.

HIGGINS, Hon. HENRY BOURNES.—B. 1851; M.L.A., Victoria, 1894-1900; chmn. of royal comsrr. on legal procedure; mem. of Austn. Fed. Convention, 1897-98, and of the first Federal parlmt.; judge of High Court, Oct., 1906.

HILL, CHARLES W., F.R.G.S.—Clk., lower div., ch. sec.'s office, Cyprus, Jan., 1886; passed in Greek, May, 1888; acted as clk., exec. coun., Aug., 1889, to Mar., 1890; and as priv. sec. to admstr., Oct., 1889, to Mar., 1890; govt. clk., shipping master, clk. of couns., and J.P., Falkland Is., 1892; also priv. sec. to gov.; ag. col. treas., collr. of customs, postmtr., &c., 1893; mem. exec. and legis. couns.; ag. col. sec., &c., 1894; special comsrr. on land question, W. Falkland, 1895; ag. inspr. of schools, 1895; special mission to S. Chili, 1897; ag. col. sec., Apr. to Oct., 1897; col. treas., collr. of cust., and postmtr., Falkland Islds., Oct., 1897; ag. col. sec., May, 1899, to June, 1900; senr. ast. treasnr., G. Coast, 1901.

HILL, DAVID YOUNG CAMPBELL.—As 6th clk., treasy., Br. Guiana, July, 1874; ag. 4th clk., Apr., 1875, to Feb., 1876; ag. 1st clk., Oct., 1877, to May, 1878; provisional 3rd clk., audit office, May, 1878; 2nd clk., treasy., 1880; ch. clk., 1881; col. book-keeper, 1886; ag. receiver-gen., 1887; again 1888; dep. recvr.-gen., Apr., 1891; acted
as rec-gen. at various periods from 1891 to 1898; dir. pub. offrs. widows and orphans fund, 1896; dir. of pub. offrs. guarantee fund; dir. of "Trotman" trust fund; ag. recvr.-gen. in 1899, 1900 and 1903; ag. comptroller of cust. in 1901 and 1905.

HILL, ERNEST.—M.R.C.S., Eng.; L.R.C.P., Lon.; dip. pub. health, Camb.; health offr. for Natal, 1st Sept., 1901; mem. of bd. of health, 21st Nov., 1901; mem. of bd. of trustees, Grey's hosp.

HILL, G.H.—Jun. clk., P.O., O.R.C., Dec., 1904; typist, audit dept., July, 1905.

HILL, J. K. D.—Entered treasv., Br. Guiana, Sept., 1879; 6th clk., Feb., 1881; 2nd book-keeper, aud. office, Apr., 1881; 1st ditto, Mar., 1882; 2nd class clk., Apr., 1889; 1st ditto, July, 1889; sec. P.W. dept. comm. of inquiry, 1889; ag. ch. clk., 1890, 1894, and 1895; ag. ch. clk., audit office, 1894-5; apptd., Sept., 1896, acctnt. sup. ct. of civ. justice, and acctnt. regis.'s office; student Lin's Inn, July, 1898; passed final exam., Mar., 1899; stip. mag., J.P., and coroner, July, 1899.

HILL, P. H. R.—Cik. and book-keeper, pol. estabtmt., Br. Guiana, Jan., 1867; sen. inspr. of pol., July, 1868; ag. inspr.-gen. of pol., July, 1872, to Apr., 1873; ag. stip. mag., Apr., 1875, to Nov., 1876, and on other occasions; as-st. pol. mag. for Georgetown, Aug., 1880; ag. sherifff of Essequibo and stip. mag., Dec., 1880, to Nov., 1881; ag. pol. mag. of Georgetown and sherifff of Demerara, 1882; clin. poor law consnr., Apr., 1885; ag. recr.-gen. at various times, 1893-8; dir. of public offrs. widows and orphans fund, 1896.

HILLMAN, GEORGE FRANCIS.—Ed. Highbury New Park Coll., Lond.; admitted to the bar of supreme ct., W. Aust., 1898; apptd. clk. of legis. coun. and clk., of parlt., June, 1901.

HILLIER, H. K.—B. 1881; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civil service, and assigned to the C.O., July, 1900; shorthand writer and asst. clk., attached to col. sec.'s off., Ceylon, Jan., 1908.

HIME, RT. HON. LIEUT.-COL. SIR A.H., P.C. (1902), K.C.M.G. (1900), C.M.G. (1876), (late R.E.).—B. 1842; entered roy. engrs. in 1861; became capt. in 1874; employed in Bermuda under col. gov't. from 1869 to 1871 in construction of a causeway and iron swing bridge connecting the island of St. George with the main island, for which he received the thanks of the legislature and the acknowledgments of the S. of S. for the cols.; col. engr. of Natal, May, 1875; mem. of exec. and legis. coun., 1876; employed on survey of boundary between Orange Free State and Natal, 1884-5; ret., 1893; mem. legis. assm., 1897; min. of canals and works, 1897; premier, Natal, 1899; resig., 18th Aug., 1903.

HINE, HUMPHREY ALBERT.—Student Zulu interp., Natal, 29th Dec., 1885; resig., 31st Jan., 1887; 3rd cls. clk., audit office, 14th Jan., 1888; transf. to treasv., 8th Apr., 1889; ag. clk., exec. coun., and clerical asst., gov'r's office, 15th Oct., 1889; ag. clk., gov'r's office, 3rd Feb., 1890, to 29th Sept., 1893; ministerial clk., col. sec.'s office, 1st Nov., 1893; 2nd cls. clk., 1st July, 1894; ag. ch. clk., gov'r's office, 1st Apr., 1895; has held appntnt. as clk., exec. coun., since 6th Dec., 1899; ag. sen. clk., agricul. dept., 12th Aug., 1897; sec. to min. of agric., 1st Jan., 1898; asst. under-sec., 1st Nov., 1901; acctng. offr., col. sec.'s dept., 1st July, 1905.

HINDE, SIDNEY LANGFORD.—Chevalier de l'Ordre Royal du Lion; ed. in France and Germany, Clare Coll., Camb., and St. Bart.'s Hosp., London; Congo Free State serv., 1891; Arab campaign, 1892 to 1894, medal and star: x. offr., E. Africa Prot., 27th Sept., 1895; Med. rebellion medal; collr., 1897; sub-comsnr., Apr., 1902.

HINDS, CHARLES JOHN CLIFFORD.—Sec. with S.A.C. in South African war, 1901-2 (Que. medal and four clasps); acctnt. to land settl. dept., O.R.C., 1st July, 1902.

HIRST, GEORGE S. S.—Ed. at Perse Sch., Camb., and Camb. and Edin. Univs.; M.B., Edin., 1883; asst. col. surg., G. Coast, 1886-9; asst. comsnr. and govt. med. offr., Salt Cay, Tr., and Caicos Is., 1905-1907; comsnr., Cayman, 1907.

HISLOP, THE HON. T. W. THOMAS.—Sec., N. Zealand, 1889-90; apptd. offr. of cl. of honour for services at Paris Exhibn., 1889.

HOAD, MAJOR-GEN. JOHN CHARLES C.M. (1900).—B. 1856; dep. adj.-gen. and chief staff of commonwealth forces of Australia. Lieut.-adjt., mounted rifles, 1886; capt., 1887; maj.-lt. 2nd in command mtd. rif., 1892; asst. adjt. and lieut.-col., 1895; col., 1899; reprtd. heads of staff, Vict., at Queen's Jubilee, London, 1902; attached to personal staff of Field-Marshal Roberts; S. Afr. War, 1899-1900, comd. 2nd Austr. regt., converted regt. into mtd. inf.; 2nd fonteine, Johannesburg, Pretoria; A.A.G., inf.; mentd. in desps., C.M.G., three desps. apptd. A.D.C. to H.E. the govr.-gen. of the crown; apptd. ch. of staff for all mil. arrange-ments for reception in Vict. of H.R.H. the Duke of Cornwall and York, and opening of Comonw. parl., 1901; Comonw. mil. attck. with Japanese army in Manchuria, and recd. of the Rising Sun from Emp. of Japan; inspr.-gen. of the forces in Australia, 1906.

HOAR, WILLIAM HENRY.—B. 1848; apptd. under prison consnr., England, after civ. ser. exam., 1892; gaoler, St. Kitts-Nevis, June, 1892, to Dec., 1898; ag. ch. keeper of prisons, Leeward Is., May to Nov., 1897; ch. warder, Belize, B. Hond., Jan., 1899; ag. keeper of prisons, B. Hond., in 1900-05-06-07-08.

HOARE, GEORGE EDWARD.—Employed in operations against Arab slave traders, E. Cent. Africa Prot., 1891-1894; medal, 1898; 2nd cls. asst., B. Cent. Africa Prot., 1898.

HOBBES, STEPHEN BARTON.—Lower mechanical clk., survr.-gen's. dept., Mauritius, 1st Jan., 1886; survr., 25th Apr., 1892; on spe duty at Seychelles, 1897-1900.

HOBLEY, CHARLES WILLIAM, C.M.G. (1904).—Geologist to Imp. Br. E. Africa Co., Mar., 1894; 1st cls. asst., Uganda Prot., Aug., 1894; asst. dep. comsnr., E. Africa Prot., 1st Apr., 1895; ag. comsnr., 27th June to 1st Aug., 1904; mem. instit. of civ. engrs.; Uganda med.; Nandi medal, 1900.

HOBSON, WILLIAM EDWARD.—B. 1856; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. in lower 2nd div. of the civ. serv., and assigned to the exec. of the consnr. of H.M.'s wrks. and pub. bldg., 1st Jan., 1886; transf. to the C.O., April, 1891; asst. regis., 1890; promoted to higher gr., Jan., 1900.

HODGE, LEONARD PERCIVAL, F.S.I.L.—Ass. M.Inst.C.E.—Ed. Queen's Coll., Taunton; King's Coll., Lond.; honors construc., 1886; cl. supt., P.W., Jamaica, 1891; 1st cl. ditta and attached to head off., 1892; dir. of roads, G. Coast, 1894, but did not take up appntnt.; clk. engr. and surv.-gen., Dominica, 1898; draughtsman, P.W.D., B. Guiana, 20th Mar., 1901; asst. engr. and draughtsman, Apr., 1906.
HODGES, AUBREY DALLAS PERCIVAL, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., M.D., Lond.—Ed. at Epsom Coll. and Lond. Hosp.; med. offr., Uganda Prot., 17th Jan., 1898.

HODGES, HON. HENRY EDWARD AGINCOURT.—B. 1844; puisne judge, Victoria, since 1889.

HODGSON, SIR FREDERIC MITCHELL, K.C.M.G. (1899), C.M.G. (1891), V.D. (1898), Kt. of Grace of Order of St. John of Jerusalem, (1903).—B. 1851; entered sav. bank dept. of Impl. P.O. and apptd., after compet. exam., Feb., 1869; was employed in the sec.'s office in connection with the transfer of the telegraphs to the state, 1868 to 1870, and apptd. clk. in that office, Aug., 1870; apptd., after further exam., to the 3rd class (grade I) of the sec.'s office, Aug., 1876; promoted to 2nd class, Aug., 1880; was sen. capt. of the 24th Middlesex (post office), R.V.; postm.-gen., Br. Guiana, Jan., 1882; col. sec., G. Coast, Sept., 1888; adminstd. the govt., June, 1889, to Feb., 1890; June to Nov., 1891; Aug., 1893, to Mar., 1894; Apr. to Oct., 1896; and Dec., 1897, to March, 1898; major comdg. the G. Coast R.V., which he raised in 1892, 1892-1900; major comdg. Barbados volr. force, which he raised in 1901, 1901-1904; gov., G. Coast, Mar., 1898; gov. Barbados, Oct., 1900; gov. B. Guiana, 16th July, 1904.

HODSON, ARNOLD WIENHOLT, F.R.G.S.—B. 1881; ed. Italy, Felsted, and Mulgrave Castle; in Central Queensland, 1900 to 1902; joined Queensland contingent for S. Africa, 1902; apptd. to Transvaal and O.R.C. repat. dept., 1902; transf. to P.W.D., Transvaal, 1903; sub-inspr. Bech. Prot. pol., 1904; has twice served as asst. res. mag. while on duty in the Kalahari Desert on the German border; twice recd. spec. approval of S. of S. for service in connection with Lelotutu missions, 1905; mem. of Ngamiland mission, 1906; S.J.P., 1907.

HOFMEYR, JAN HENDRIK.—Formerly mem. for Stellenbosch in Cape house of assembly; mem. of exec. coun., 1881; deleg. to col. confce., 1887 and 1894.

HOGUE, HON. JAMES ALEXANDER.—B. 1846; M.L.A. for The Glebe, New S. Wales since 1894; min. of pub. instr. and min. for labour, 1889-9; col. sec., 1904-7; min. of pub. instrn. and min. for labour since May, 1907.

HOLDEN, GEORGE.—Asst. supt. of wks., S. Stlttns., June, 1901; supt. of wks., Prov. Wellesley, Jan., 1908; supt. of wks. and surveys, Singapore, July, 1908.

HOLDER, THE HON. FREDERICK WILLIAM, K.C.M.G. (1902).—B. 1850; mem. of house of assem., S. Australia, 1887; treasr., 1889 to Aug., 1890; premier and treasr., June to Oct., 1892; comsrr. of public works, June, 1893, to Apr., 1894; treasr., Apr., 1894, to Dec., 1899; premier and treasr., Dec., 1899, to May, 1901; mem. hse. of represent., Austnl. parl., 1901; speaker, 1901.

HOLLAND, BERNARD H., C.B. (1904).—B. 1856; ed. at Eton and Triin. Coll., Camb.; called to bar, Inner Temp., 1882; in office of charity comsrr., 1884-1890; priv. sec. to Duke of Devonshire, 1892-1894; sec. to royal comsrr. on financial relations between Great Britain and Ireland, 1894-1896; to Ld. Rothschild's comtees on old-age pensions, 1896-1898; to Transvaal concessions comsrr., 1900-1901; to royal comsrr. on Port of London, 1901-2; and to royal comsrr. on war in S. Africa, 1902-3; priv. sec. to Right Hon. Alfred Lyttelton, S. of S. for the colonies, 1903; ditto to Lord Elgin, 1905-1908; author of "Imperium et Libertas," etc.

HOLLAND, J.—B. 1858; apptd. after exam., 3rd cl. messenger, C.O., 18th Aug., 1902; 2nd cl. ditto, 10th June, 1904.

HOLLINGSWORTH, A. H.—A.M. Inst. C.E.; ed. King's Coll., London, engineering dept.; art. pupil, borough and water engr., Croydon; asst. engr., P.W.D., Hong-Kong, Dec., 1896; ag. exec. engr., in charge of water and drain. wks., Aug., 1900; ag. consulting sanitary survr., Sept., 1900; exec. engr. in charge of water and drain. wks., 1st Jan., 1902.

HOLLIS, ALFRED CLAUD.—Ed. Highgate and St. Leonards, and in Switzerland and Germany; asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., 12th Mar., 1897; collr., 15th June, 1900; ag. Brit. vice-consul for German East Africa, Apr., 1900, to Feb., 1901; ag. sec. to admnstr. and priv. sec. to H.M. consmr. from Feb., 1901, to Apr., 1903; sec. to the admnstr., 1st Apr., 1903; reg.-gen. of marriages, 1st Dec., 1902; reg.-gen. of births and deaths, 1st Oct., 1904; sec. for native affairs, 13th June, 1907; African general serv. medal, Jubaland clasp.

HOLME, HENRY FREDERICK.—4th clk., col. sec.'s office, Antigua, Leeward Islands, 1898; ag. 3rd clk., 1898 and 1900; ag. priv. sec., 1900 and 1901; ag. 2nd clk., 1900 and 1905; 2nd clk., 1901; supt., printing office, 1905; ag. asst. col. sec., 1906, 1907, and 1908; clk., legis. coun., Antigua, 1908.

HOLMES, JOHN RICHARD.—S.S.C., 1879; barrister, Mid. Tem., 1889; dist. consmr., G. Coast, 1889; commanded detachment in Awoonah expdn., 1889-91; pres. dist. ct., Cyprus, 1899.

HOLROYD, SIR EDWARD DUNIAS, KT. BACH. (1903).—B. 1828; ed. at Winchester (Queen's gold medal for Latin and English essays), Trin. Coll. Camb. (B.A. 1st cls. tripus, 1851, M.A., 1854), student, Gray's Inn, 1851; called to the bar, 1855; called to Victorian bar, 1859; Tasmanian bar, 1867; Q.C., 1879; raised to bench, Aug., 1881; ex-pres. of Impl. Fed. League of Victoria; sen. puisne judge of sup. ct. of Victoria; ret. 1st Aug., 1906.

HOLTZEB, MAURICE WM., F.I.S., etc.—Govt. gardener, Port Darwin, 1878; botanic gardener, 1889; dir. botanic garden, Adelaide, 1891.

HOMAGEE, JAMES FRANCIS, I.S.O. (1906).—Court messenger, St. Helena, 1859; clk. o ch. just., 1862; man. govt.savings bk., 1865; clk. of the peace, taxing master, and registr. sup. ct., 1847; legal adviser, crown prosecutor, and registr. V.-A. ct., 1870; also supervisor of customs and registr. of shipping, in 1883; admity. advoc., 1890.

HOMBURGI, ROBERT.—Mem. of H. of Ass., S. Aust., since 1884; atty.-gen., 1890-92 and 1892-3; ditto and min. of educn., 1904-5; 3rd judge of sup. ct., 1905.

HONEY, JOHN WM., C.M.G. (1908).—Served under Cape govt., 1880 to 1901; transf. to Transvaal when collr. and prin. controller of cust. and prin. registr. of shipping; served in Gaika-Galeka and Basutoland campaigns, holding comsrr. in latter as lieut. Capetown Rifles; dir. of cust., Transvaal, and cust. adviser to high comsrr., 16th May, 1901; M.L.C., Mem. I.C.C.; chrmn., tender and post office investment boards.

HONEY, DE SYMONS MONTAGU GEORGE.—Served in B.S.A. Co.'s expdt., to Mashonaland, 1891 to 1893; with B. C. Africa admnstr., 1893 to 1896; cust. dept., Transvaal, 9th Apr., 1901; native affairs dept., 1902; sec. for Swaziland affairs, and acting offr., 20th Oct., 1904; govt. sec., Swaziland adminstr., 22nd Mar., 1907.
"Cartier," and "Les États-Unis, origines, constitution et développement."

DE FENZI, CHARLES WILLIAM PERKS DOUGLAS. Clk., ast. and librarian, legis. coun., Natal, 5th Feb., 1889; sec. to coun., on stock importation, 1889-90; sec. to, bot. gardens coun., 1891; sec. to coun., on scab and stock diseases, 1894-5; clk. of the legis. coun., on introduction of resp. govt., 10th Oct., 1893.

DE FREITAS, ANTHONY, B.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1869; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn; ag. pol. mag., Grenada, 1900 and 1901; ag. atty.-gen., St. Vincent, 1902; ag. regis., sup. ct., Grenada, 1902, to 1904; ag. ch. just., St. Vincent, May to Oct., 1904; stip. mag. and coroner, 1st dist., St. Lucia, Oct., 1904; atty.-gen., St. Lucia, 4th Apr., 1907.

DE GRITCHY, A. NICOLLE M.B.C.M., Edin.—Ast. med. offr., and J.P., Victoria, Seychelles, and outlying islands, 11th Sept., 1901; col. surg., S. Nigeria, Apr., 1906.

DE HAMEL, HARGRAVE BARRY, Major, Londonderry Artillery; astl. supt. of pol., Straits Stltnts., June, 1897; seconded as ag. astl. commr. of pol., Kunta, Perak, Dec., 1905; supt. of pol., Penang, May, 1907.

DE KRETSER, EDWARD, I.S.O. (1903)—B. 1854; employed in col. sec.'s off., Ceylon, 8th May, 1872; astl. and gen., 1st Jan., 1901; astl. commr. of rev., Mar., 1907.

DE LA CORNILLIERE, HENRI GASTON ERNEST, Draughtsman, P.W.D. of late O.F.S., Nov., 1892, to Mar., 1900; architectural astl., P.W.D., O.R.C., Mar., 1900, to July, 1902; head of architectural drawing off., ditto, July, 1902.

DELAFAYE, SIR LOUIS VICTOR, KT. BACH. (1898).—B. 1842; called to bar Mid. Term., 1863; mun. councillor, St. Louis, 1870; prov. judge, sup. ct., Mauritius, Mar., 1879; mem. prison bd., Jan., 1884; mem. civ. ser. inquiry coun., Feb., 1884; mem. civ. ser. coun., Aug., 1884-5; ag. puisne judge, 1884-5, and May, 1890, to July, 1892; Q.C., Aug., 1892; puisne judge, Nov., 1894; ag. chief justice, June, 1898; chief judge, Dec., 1898.

DE MARTIN, G. P., B.A., Dublin; jun. astl. master, Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, 1904.

DE MELLO, ALOYSIUS, B. 1880; B.A.; ed. at St. Patrick's Sch., Karashi, St. Peter's Coll., Camb., and in France; mem. of hon. soc'y of Gray's Inn; law tripes, Camb., 1902; cadet, S. Stltnts., 27th Nov., 1903; astl. prot. of Chinese, Singapore, 13th Apr., 1904; proceeded to study Chinese at Canton, 6th Dec., 1904; ag. supt., money order branch and savings bank, Singapore, 3rd Sept., 1906; passed final exam. in Cantonese, 3rd Oct., 1906; passed cadet, 21st Jan., 1907; ag. sheriff and dep. regist., sup. ct., Penang, and astl. offr., assignee, Penang, 14th May, 1907; ag. dep. regist., sup. ct., Singapore, Apr., 1908; is mag. for Singapore and Penang.

DENHAM, HON. DIGBY FRANK.—B. 1859; M.L.A. for Oxley, Queensland, since 1902; min. for agric. and pub. wks., Sept., 1905; min. for agric. and rlyws., Jan., 1906; resigned, Feb., 1907.

DENHAM, EDWARD BRANDIS.—B. 1876; ed. at Malvern and Merton Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1899; cadet, Ceylon, Nov., 1899; extra off. astl. govt. agt. West. Prov., Dec., 1899; astl. govt. agt., Mannar, Feb., 1902; ag. 2nd astl. coll. sec., May, 1904, and Feb.-Mar., 1905; astl. govt. N. Prov. for pearl fishery work, Mar., 1905; 2nd astl. coll. sec. and sec., agric. bd., priv. sec. to O.A.G., Sept., 1905; organising sec., agric. bd., Dec., 1905; landing survr., cust., Colombo, June, 1906.

DENMAN, ROBERT.—B. 1860; ed. Marlborough Coll., and Guy's Hosp.; M.R.C.S. Eng., 1886; L.S.A. Lond., 1886; D.Ph., Cantab., 1905; govt. med. offr., Seychelles, 1886; ch. med. offr., 1900; hea. med. offr., Perak, 1908.

DENNETT, R. E.—Ed. at Marlborough; served in the Congo, 1879-1902; inspr. of forests, S. Nigeria, 1902; astl. conservator of forests, 1st grade, 1904; author of "Seven Years among the Fjords," "Notes on the Folklore of the Fjords," and "At the Back of the Black Man's Mind."

DENNISTOUN, HON. JOHN EDWARD.—B. 1845; puisne judge, N. Zealand, since Feb., 1889.

DENT, FRANKLAND, M. Sc., Ph.D., F.I.C.—Astl. govt. analyst, Singapore, Aug., 1905; govt. analyst and science lecturer, S. Stltnts., Mar., 1906.

DENT, CYRIL WYNTER.—B. 1869; ed. at Winchester Coll.; inspr., reputation accts., O.R.C., 1902; aud., ditto, 1902; ch. elk., audit dept., O.R.C., July, 1905.

DENTON, SIR GEORGE CHARDIN, K.C.M.G. (1900), C.M.G. (1891),—B. 1851; ensign, 57th regt., Oct., 1869; lieut., May, 1871; adjt., Aug., 1876; capt., Jan., 1878; chief of pol., St. Vincent, Apr., 1880; apptd. one of the consuls to inquire into the pol. force, Barbados, Oct., 1880; mem. of exec. coun., Oct., 1881; represented St. Vincent at telegraphic conferece, at Barbados, May, 1882; admstd. govt. St. Vincent, May to July, 1880; again in 1886, and from Nov., 1887, to Mar., 1888; ag. col. sec., 1886 to 1888; col. sec., Lagos, Mar., 1888; admstd. govt. on many occasions, 1888-1900; apptd. lieut. governor, 1900; admmsr. of Gambia, Nov., 1900; gov., Mar., 1901.

DE PIRO, GIUSEPPE LORENZO, MARCHESE, C.M.G. (1885).—B. 1858; late hon. sec., comte of privileges, Maltese nobility.

DERAVIN, EUGENE E.—Rev. offr., St. Kitts, 1893; 1st rev. and excise offr., 1897; ag. astl. treas., Sept., 1904, and June, 1905.

DERINZY, GEORGE CASTIGLIONI.—B. 1865; ed. at St. Columbus Coll., Co. Dublin; lieut., 3rd batt., E. Yorks. regt., 1885; transf'd to Donegal Artil., 1887; capt., 1890; dist. inspr. of pol., B. Guiana, 1891; on spec. serv. to Venezuelan boundary (Uran), 1895; county inspr. of pol., 1896; "extra" certif. musketry, Hythe, 1900; chief count inspr. of pol., and supt. of George town fire brig., Nov., 1903; author of "Firemen—Manual for B. Guiana"; ag. inspr.-gen. of pol. on several occasions; inspr.-gen. of pol. and col. commdg. local forces, B. Guiana; also inspr. of prisons, 31st July, 1908.

DE ROS, COLIN JOSEPH FERNANDES STANISLAUS.—Ed. at Catholic gram. schl., Georgetown, B. Guiana; served as a volunteer, customs, 1st Apr. to 31st Dec., 1885; 6th cls. offr., 1st Jan., 1886; 5th cls. offr., 16th Dec., 1886; 4th cls. offr., 1st Sept., 1892; 3rd cls. offr., 4th June, 1896; 2nd cls. offr., 14th Sept., 1905; ag. offr., astl. to comptroller in excise matters, 1st June to 31st Aug., 1902; ag. 1st cls. offr., 9th Aug., 1906.

DE SARAM, J.H., C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1844; writer to the govt. of Ceylon, 1865; pol. mag. of Balapiti-medura, 1866; dist. judge, Badulla, Oct., 1867; commr. of requests, Colombo, 1868; dist. judge, Kurunegala, 1875; regis.-gen., Colombo, 1886; dist. judge, Kalutara, Dec., 1883; regis.-gen., May, 1886; dist. judge, Jaffna, Aug., 1891; ditto, Galle, Dec., 1891; ditto, Kandy, Aug., 1893; ret.

DESHON, EDWARD, C.M.G. (1902).—B. 1836; mem. of land bd., Queensland; ensign in 68th L.I., June, 1854; lieut., Dec., 1854; served with 68th
L.I., at siege and fall of Sebastopol, from Nov., 1854, to end of the war; medal and clasp, and Turkish medal; instructor of musketry to the 68th L.I. from Nov., 1837, to Oct., 1861; passed compet. exam. for admission to Staff Coll., in July, 1861; ret. by sale of comsn. in Oct., 1861; audit.-gen., Queensland, 1890; ret. 1901.

DESMARAIS, HENRY EUGENE.—Called to the bar, Mid. Tem., Apr., 1866; pol. mag., Rodrigues, June, 1875; dist. judge and stip. mag., Seychelles, Nov., 1879; ag. ch. civ. comsnr. on several occasions; ag. mag., Moka, Apr. to Sept., 1882; dist. mag., Moka, Aug., 1884; ag. pol. and additional mag., Port Louis, Nov., 1884; dist. mag., Moka, Dec., 1885; ag. jun. dist. mag., Port Louis, May to October, 1886; Mar., 1887, to Jan., 1888; dist. and stip. mag., Moka, July, 1889.

DESMIDT, HENRY, C.M.G. (1901), B.A. (Cape Univ.), F.S.S.—B. 1845; entered the service in Mar., 1865; permanent under col. sec. of the col. of Cape of Good Hope, and perm. head of convicts and prisons dept., holding in addition the following offices: (1) accounting off., col. sec.'s dept.; (2) controller printing and statary; (3) mem. civ. ser. comsn.; (4) mem. tender bid.; (5) custodian stamps; (6) admstr. food and drugs act; (7) inspr. emigr. coolie ships. Was specially charged with the duties of dir. of the census of 1891; received congratulations of the govt., and was awarded an honorarium of 500l. specially voted by parlmt.; elected fellow of roy. statistical soc., 1892; asst. treas., July, 1898; ret. 1904.

DESVEUX, SIR GEORGE W., G.C.M.G. (1893), K.C.M.G. (1883), C.M.G. (1877).—B. 1834; ed. Charterhouse, and Balliol Coll., Oxon. Called to the bar of Upper Canada, 1861; stip. mag., Br. Guiana, 1863; admstr. of the govt., St. Lucia, 1869; ag. gov. of Trinidad, Jan., 1877, to Jan., 1878; ag. gov. of Fiji, June, 1878, to Sept., 1879; gov. Bahamas, 1880; gov., Fiji, 1880-6; asst. high comsnr., W. Pacific, 1880, and high comsnr., 1882-5; gov. of Newfoundland, 1886; of Hong Kong, 1887; ret. 1891.

DEVILLIERS, Rt. Hon. SIR JOHN, P.C. (1897), K.C.M.G. (1882), KT. BACH. (1877).—B. 1842; ch. justice of the sup. ct., C. of Good Hope, 1874; atty.-gen. from 1872 to 1874; for several years mem. of the legis. assem.; pres. of the legis. comn., and mem. of the comn. of the Univ. of C. of Good Hope in 1873; one of the roy. comsn. for the settlement of the affairs of the Transvaal, 1881; represented the Cape at the col. confece., Ottawa, 1884; mem. of judicial comte., H.M. privy comn., 1897; represented S. Africa at Quebec Tercentenary celebrrations, 1908.

DE WAAL, NICHOLAS FREDERICK.—M.L.A. for Colesberg, Cape Colony, 1901; col. sec., Cape Colony, 1908.

DEWAR, ARTHUR R. J.—Capt., 5th Royal Warwickshire Regt.; comp. comdr., Malay States Guides, Apr., 1902; asst. supt.of pol., Singapore, Sept., 1905.

DEWAR, HAROLD JAMES.—B. 1878; apptd. elk., repatriation, O.R.C., 23rd Apr., 1902; ditto, British refugee aid, 1st July, 1903; ditto, treasy., 1st July, 1903; examr. of accts., treasy., 4th Apr., 1906.

DEWDNAYE, THE HON. EDGAR.—Lieut.-gov. of N.W. territories, 1881; min. of interior, Canada, 1888; lieut.-gov., Br. Columbia, 1892-7.

DE WET, THE HON. SIR JACOBUS ALBERTUS, K.C.M.G. (1890).—B. 1840; mem. Cape house of assem. and exec. comn.; min. for native affairs, 1884; Br. agent, S.A. Republic, June, 1890; ret. on pension, Sept., 1896.

DE WILTON, MAJOR ALBERT WALTER—Lieut., Lancashire militia, 1881; lieut., Connaught Rangers, 1883 to 1886; lieut.; Indian staff corps, 1886 to 1894; capt., ditto, 10th Mar., 1894; major, ditto, 10th July, 1891; served in Burma campaign, 1885, 1887, 1889 (medal and two clasps); insp.-gen. of pol., Mauritius, 29th Oct., 1898; insp.-gen. of pol. and prisons, Ceylon, 18th Aug., 1902.

DIAS, FELIX REGINALD, M.A., LL.M. Trin. Hall, Camb.—Called to the bar, Inner Tem., May, 1887; pol. mag. and comsnr. of requests, Gampola, Ceylon, Oct., 1889; crown counsel for the island, July, 1893; additn. dist. judge, Colombo, July, 1906.

DICK, JOHN NORMAN, M.I.M.E. B. 1853; govt. engnr. surv., Penang, 1888; ag. gov. marine surv., Singapore, June, 1895, to June, 1896; govt. mar. surv., and examnr. of engnr., Singapore, March, 1901; ag. inspr. of marine surveys, S. Stiltns., May, 1908.

DICKSON, THOMAS.—B. 1869; ed. Fettes Coll., Edin.; served in Boer war in 1st cont., Ceylon M.I., Jan., 1900, to Jan., 1901 (medal and 3 clasps); and in S.A.C. from Jan., 1901, to June, 1902 (King's medal and 2 clasps); temp. apptd. ch. elk., land setttn. dept., O.R.C., 10th Oct., 1901; asst. sec., land setttn., 12th Aug., 1903; sec., land setttn., 23rd Jan., 1905; ag. dir., land setttn., 14th May to 14th Nov., 1906.

DILLON, ALBERT BARROW.—B. 1867; ed. Queen's Roy. Coll., Trinidad; elk. to inspr. of schls., B. Hond., 1893; ag. elk. to auditor and in treasy. and customs, 1893; elk. to col. engr., 1895; ag.-insp. of schls., 1895-8; 2nd elk., treasy. and cust., 1897; insp. of schls., June, 1898; ag. sup. bot. station, 28th Sept. to 31st Dec., 1904; ag. ch. elk., C.S.O., and elk. of comns., 29th June, 1905, to 14th Jan., 1906.

DISCOMBE, JOHN.—Apptd., after compet. exam., 3rd class elk., sup. ct., Gibraltar; 2nd class elk. (supernumerary), Jan., 1899; ag. asst. regis., Nov., 1899; asst. regis. and dep. elk. of arrngs., Jan., 1900; ag. regis. and admstr.-gen., July to Sept., 1901.

DOBIE, EDWARD DAVID.—B. 1857; barrister, etc., sup. ct., Tasmania, admitted July, 1882; joined civ. ser., Tasmania, Mar., 1883; was partly draftsman and afterwards solr.-gen., from Mar. to May, 1887; cr. solr. from 30th May, 1887, to 1895; sec., law dept., to 1898; then recorder, Launceston, to 1st Apr., 1901; solr.-gen. and crown solr., and grand juror, 1st Apr., 1901.

DOBBS, CECIL MOORE.—Ed. St. Columba's Coll., Rathfarnham, and Trin. Coll., Dublin; B.A. Classics (honours); asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., 25th Oct., 1906.

DOBERCK, DR. W.—Astronomer in charge of Markree Observ., co. Sligo, 1874-83; dir. Hong Kong Observ. since 1883; has published twenty volumes of observations and researches in Hong Kong, a pamphlet "On the Law of Storms in the Eastern Seas," and over 200 papers on scientific subjects in transactions of learned societies and scientific periodicals in Europe and America.

DODDS, THE HON. SIR JOHN STOKES, K.C.M.G. (1901), KT. BACH (1900), C.M.G. (1889).—B. 1848; att.-gen., Tasmania, Dec., 1878, to Oct., 1879, and in the Giblin ministry, Oct., 1879; col. treas. from Dec., 1881, to Aug., 1884; att.-gen. in the Douglas ministry from Aug., 1884, to Mar., 1886; also premier, Mar. to Dec., 1886; judge, sup. ct., 1886; deleg. col. confece., 1887; ch. just., 1898; Chancellor of Univ. of Tasmania;
administered govt., 1899, 1900-1, 1904 and 1908; lt.-gov., 3rd Aug., 1903.

DODDS, WILLIAM JOHN.—B. 1854; M.D. (Edin.), 1879, gold medallist, M.B. and C.M., 1876; 1st class honours, D.Sc., 1878; inspr. of asyls. and med. supt. of Valkenberg asyl., Cape, 1889.

DOHERTY, C. J.—Puisne judge, sup. ct., Quebec, 1891.

DOLBEY, HUGH OWEN.—Ed. Dulwich Coll. and Lond. Univ.; called to the bar, June, 1901, Mid. Tem., Oxford circuit; regiar., E. Africa Prot., and prim. regiar. of documents, 29th Apr., 1904; mag., 1907.

DONALD, RANALD.—Uganda Rly. mag., 9th Oct., 1900; mag., Nairobi, E. Africa Prot., 13th Sept., 1902; inspr.-gen. of pol., 24th Nov., 1905.

DONNAN, J., C.M.G. (1902).—B. 1837; mast. attendant, Colombo, Ceylon, 1863; was comdr. of govt. steamers, "Manchester" and "Pearl," from July, 1859; ret., 1902.

DONNELLY, W. J. S.—Survr.-gen., Newfoundland, to 1882; rec.-gen., 1882; resig., 1889; M.L.A. for Placentia, 1893; rec.-gen. and mem. exec. coun., Apr. to Dec., 1894; M.H.A., Placentia, 1897; rec.-gen., 1898; inspr. of cust., 1902.

DONOVAN, JUSTIN FOLEY, M.D., M.CH.L.M.—Med. offr. and health offr., Killeagh dispensary, co. Cork, 1876 to 1879; surg., R.N., 1879; received thanks of the admiralty, 1882 and 1888, "for zeal and devotion to duty" at R.N. hosps., Port Royal and Malta; and of the med. dir.-gen., R.N., for professional work, 1882-46; ret. from the navy 1889; med. attendant, lepers' home, pub. gen. hosp. and constab. training depot, Spanish Town, Jamaica, 1889; med. examr., civ. ser. widows' and orphans' pension fund, 1890.

DOUGLAS, ARCHIBALD CAMPBELL.—B. 1872; ed. Radley Coll. and Oxford Military Coll.; apptd. a consular asst. on the Niger Coast Protec., Dec., 1894; asst. dist. consmr., Feb., 1896; member, Lincoln's Inn, 1898; transport offr. in Qua Ibo dist. punitive exped., Feb. and Mar., 1899 (West African medal); promoted to rank of 2nd cl. offr., S. Nig., Jan., 1901; served as political offr. with Aro field force, Jan. to Feb., 1902 (medal); polit. offr. to Ekel expdn., 1898 (medal and clasp); dist. consmr., 1st Apr., 1904.

DOUGLAS, R. STAIR.—Cadet, Sarawak serv., Nov., 1896; asst. res., June, 1899; res. 2nd cl., Jan., 1902; 2nd cl. res., Baran dist., 1904.

DOUGLASS, WALTER JOHN, B.A., LL.B.—Ed. at Trin. Coll., Camb.; admitted solr., 1889; dist. consmr., Lagos, 1897-1900; admitted solr., Leeward Is., 1901; called to the Bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1903; Leeward Is. Bar, Jan., 1904; stip. mag. and coroner, 1st dist., St. Lucia, Oct., 1907; ag. atty.-gen., St. Lucia, 4th Oct., 1908.

DOWER, EDWARD EBENEZER.—Cik., ch. mag.'s off., Kokstad, C. Colony, Oct., 1891; Matatiele, Jan., 1896; nat. affairs offr., Aug., 1896; prin. elk., 1900; ch. elk., July, 1901; also acting offr., Prime Minister's dept., July, 1904; asst. sec. to nat. affairs dept., July, 1906; sec. to ditto, Sept., 1907.

DOWNER, THE HON. SIR J. W., K.C.M.G. (1887), K.C.—B. 1844; att.-gen., S. Australia, June, 1881, to June, 1884, and att.-gen. and premier, 1885-7; del. to col. conf., 1887; ch. sec. and premier, 1892-3; mem. of senate, Australian parl., 1901-1903; mem. leg. coun., S. Aust., 1896.

DOWNES, MAJOR-GEN. M. FRANCIS, C.M.G. (1885), late R.A.—B. 1834; served in the Crimea till June, 1856, medal and clasp an Turkish medal; instructor of fortif., R.M. Coll. Sandhurst, for two years; commanded artillery in Mauritius and St. Helena for four years; instructor of gunnery at Woolwich five years; col.-comdt. S. Australia, June, 1877; mem. of roy. comm. on defences, Sydney, 1881; sec. of defence, Victoria, Apr., 1883, to Mar., 1888; consult., S. Australian forces, Apr., 1888-92; ret., 1902.

DOYLE, EDWARD ANGEL GAYNES.—B. 1859; M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Lond.; obstet. soc., Lond.; mem. Br. med. assoc.; late asst. house surg., Westminster hosp.; joined med. service, Trinidad, 1884; ag. dist. med. offr., 1886; res. surg., San Fernando hosp., Nov., 1892; ag. res. surg., col. hosp., Port of Spain, 1893; res. surg., ditto, 1897; D.M.O., S. Naparima, 1906.

DRAKE, THE HON. JAS. GEORGE.—Mem. leg. ass., Queensland, 1888, 1893, 1896, 1899; M.L.C., 12th Dec., 1899; sec. for pub. instrn. and P.M.G., Queensland, Dec. 1899, to Feb., 1901; senator for Queensland, Commonwealth parl., Mar., 1901; P.M.G., Commonwealth, Feb., 1902, to Aug., 1903; min. of def., Aug.-Sept., 1903; atty.-gen., Sept., 1903; vice-pres. of ex. coun., 1904; ret., 1906.

DRAKE-BROCKMAN, RALPH EVELYN.—B. 1875; ed. Elizabeth Coll., Guernsey, Dulwich Coll. and St. George's hosp.; open scholarship, St. George's hosp., 1st year's proficiency prize and Pollock prize; M.R.C.S., Eng., L.R.C.P., Lond.; apptd. surg.-capt., attached to railway pioneer regt., S.A.F.F., Dec., 1899 (medal and 2 clasps); med. offr., Uganda Prot., 26th Sept., 1900; Nandi expdn., 1900 (medal and clasp); Suk-Turkana expdn., 1901 (ment. in desh. spec. ment. by Sir H. Johnston, G.C.M.G., K.C.B., recd. appreciation of serv. from S. of S. for Foreign Affairs); med. offr., Somaliland Prot., May, 1904; recd. appreciation from S. of S. for the Colonies for serv. during smallpox epidemic in Berbera, Somaliland Prot., 1904-5; passed in Somali language, Dec., 1905.

DRAYSON, MATTHEW JOHN.—B. 1855; apptd., after compet. exam., a clerk in the lower (now 2nd) div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., May, 1883; asst. registr., May, 1892; promoted to higher grade 2nd div., July, 1896; seconded for service as chief clerk, col. sec. s off., Hong Kong, 11th Jan., 1902; acted as clk. of coun., Aug., 1902; retld. to C.O. as dep. ch. registr., 22nd July, 1905.

DRAYTON, EDWARD RAWLE, C.M.G. (1902).—B. 1859; clk. col. sec. s office, Barbados, Sept., 1878; 2nd elk. in office of gov.-in-chief of the Windward Is., July, 1879; ag. ch. elk., May, 1880, and May, 1881, to Jan., 1882; ch. elk., Jan., 1882; ag. col. sec., Grenada, Apr., 1883; priv. sec. to Maj.-gen. Browne, July to Oct., 1884; provost-marshal, Grenada, Apr., 1885; ag. col. registr., Sept., 1885; registr. sup. et., J.P., July, 1886; mem. legis. coun., May, 1887; inspr. of prisons, Mar., 1888; mem. exec. coun., Nov., 1888; treas., May, 1890; ag. col. sec., Oct., 1890, to June, 1892; col. sec. and registr.-gen., June, 1892; admstl. govt. of Grenada whenever gov. absent, 1890-1907; gov. of St. Vincent, June, 1893, Feb. to Sept., 1897, and Feb., 1900, to Apr., 1901; and of Windward Is., Jan., 1897, and Oct., 1907; delegate to W. Indian quarantine conf., Apr., 1904; deleg. to Canadian trade conf., Jan., 1908.

DRURY, EDWARD HERBERT MERIVALE.—Trinity Hall, Camb., 1890; called to the bar,
Inner Temp., 1896; priv. sec. to Hon. Sir R. G. W. Herbert, G.C.B., Mar., 1899, to June, 1900; priv. sec. to Govr. Sir C. A. Moloney, K.C.M.G., Windward Is., July, 1900; ditto, Trinidad, Dec., 1900, to July, 1902; ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, St. Helena, Oct., 1902; emigrn. agt., Oct., 1902; clk. to ex. coun., Apr., 1903; J.P., Nov., 1902; schl. attndce. offr., Aug., 1904; collr. of govt. rents and taxes, Jan., 1903, to Dec., 1906; asst. stip. mag., Nov., 1904; clk. to res. commr., Bech. Prot., Jan., 1907; ag. ch. clk. and regis., June, 1907.

DRURY, R. FREDERICK, A.M.I.C.E.—Asst. land survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1887; asst. inspr. of bldgs. and asst. sanitary survr., 1888; ag. land survr. and asst. engrnr. on extraordinary pub. wks., 1890; annually recurrent wks., 1892 and 1894; duties in connection with black plague, 1894; ag. sanitary engrnr., 1895; ag. exec. engrnr. for annually recurrent wks., 1897.

DU BOULAY, ED.—Ag. clk. to audr. and treasr., St. Lucia, Jan. to May, 1890; 4th clk., treasr., Mar. to May, 1892; 3rd clk., May to Dec., 1892; 2nd clk., treasr., and accnt., Jan., 1893, to Apr., 1894; ag. clk., treasr., Feb. to Nov., 1893; audit clk., Apr., 1894; ag. audr., St. Lucia, Mar. to Sept., 1901; attached to Somerset house for service in W. African colonies, Dec., 1901; local auditor, S. Leone, 24th Apr., 1903.

DUDER, T. C.—J.P., Newfoundland, 1874; M.H.A., Fogo, since 1893; financial sec., 1894; chmn. bd. of wks., 1894; survr.-gen. and chmn. bd. of agricul., 1897; min. agricul. and mines, 1898; stip. mag., Bonne Bay, 1901.

DUDLEY, Rt. Hon. Earl of, P.C. (1902), G.C.M.G. (1908); G.C.V.O. (1903).—B. 1867; L.C.C., a D.L. and co. ald. for Worcester; Lord High Steward of Kidderminster; major, Worcester, I.Y.; served in S. Africa, 1900; parly. sec. to B. of T., 1895-1902; lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1902-1905; gov.-gen. and comdr.-in-chief of Commonwealth of Australia, 16th Apr., 1908.

DUFF, HECTOR LIVINGSTONE.—B. 1872; appd. by F.O., asst. collr., B.C. Africa, 1897; ag. collr. dist. of W. Nyasa, 1898; Zomba, 1899; resig. from serv., 1903; re-appd., Apr., 1904; collr., Mlanji dist., May, 1904; ag. collr., Blantyre dist., 1905; res. of Mlanji, Apr., 1906; ag. res., Blantyre, Feb., 1907; author of "Nyasa land under the F.O.," 2nd edition; and a history of Nyasa land in the native dialect, published by the Prot. govt.

DUFF, GIANT, THE Rt. Hon. Sir M. E., P.C., G.C.S.I., C.I.E., F.R.S. (1880).—B. 1829; ed. at Balliol Coll., Oxford; B.A. 1850; under-sec. of state for India, 1868 to 1874; lord rector of Aberdeen Univ., 1868 to 1872; parly. under-sec. of state for the cols., Apr., 1880, to Aug., 1881; M.P. for Elgin dist., 1857 to 1881; gov. of Madras, 1881-6.

DUFF, ROBERT.—Record clk., imigrn. dept., Br. Guiana, Apr., 1883; 4th clk., Aug., 1884; 3rd clk., Oct., 1885; 2nd clk., Mar., 1893; ch. clk., Jan., 1894; imigrn. agt. and ch. clk., July, 1898; sen. imigrn. agt., Jan., 1903; imigrn. agt.-gen., 1st June, 1906; awarded 1st class certif. in Hindustani, Mar., 1885; mem. of ct. of policy and of exec. coun.

DUFFIELD, S.—Clk. to acctng. offr., Cape govt. rlys., 1897; bkpr. to ch. acctnt., O.F.S. (afterwards Imp. military) rlys., Oct., 1897, to 11th June, 1900; 1st clk. and bkpr. to orphan master, O.R.C., 11th June, 1900, to 1st Apr., 1903; asst. mast. of High Ct., O.R.C., 1st Apr., 1903; ag. mast. of High Ct., Jan. to June, 1906.

DUFFIELD, THOMAS.—Entered crown lands office, S. Australia, Mar., 1867; ch. clk. and imigrn. offr., crown lands and imigrn. dept., 1877; capt. mil. force, 1881; sec. crown lands dept.; mem. of central land and pastoral bds., 1896-1905; sec., crown lands dept., and ch. inspr. of fisheries, Nov., 1901.

DUFFY, CHAS. GAVAN, C.M.G. (1904).—Called to the Bar, 1880; clk. to the House of Representatives, C. of A., since July, 1901.

DUFFY, THE HON. JOHN GAVAN.—B. 1844; eldest son of the late Sir Charles Gavan Duffy; ed. at Stonyhurst; vice-chancellor's prize, English essay, Melbourne Univ.; succeeded his father in representation of Dalhousie in legis. assm. of Victoria, 1874; pres. of bd. of land and wks. of Victoria, 1880; postmr.-gen. of Victoria, 1890; also atty.-gen., 1892; mem. of cabinet without portfolio, 1892; resig. Jan., 1893; again postmr.-gen., 1894 to 1899; rep. Victoria at premier's confsc. at Sydney, 1896; rep. Victoria at Fed. Coun. of Aust., Hobart, 1883, when he was chmn. of standing comttee; rep. Victoria at postal confscs. 1891, 1892-5; rep. Aust. and Fiji at postal confscs. at Washington, 1897.

DUKE, MANSEGH PACE, M.R.C.P., and L.R.C.S.I., L.M. (1875).—B. 1852; ed. Academic inst., and Meath hosp., Dub.; med. offr., dist. 2, Dominica, 1875 to 1880; asst. surg., Gold Coast, 1880-1; med. offr., dist. 2, Montserrat, May, 1886; offl. mem. legis. coun., Jan., 1888; med. offr., dist. 1, and med. offr. of health, Oct., 1889; mem. exec. coun., Sept., 1893; mem. pub. lib. comtce., Oct., 1896; ex officio mem. bd. of health, Jan., 1897; J.P., Apr., 1897; ag. escheator-gen., July, 1898; holds dormant comn., July, 1898, to act as comntr., and has so acted on numerous occasions; resig. dormant comn., July, 1907.

DUKES, HUGH ROBSON.—Senr. asst., Boy's Model Sch., Pietermaritzburg, Natal, 1st Feb., 1893; headmaster, Stanger schl., 1st July, 1895; ag. inspr. of schls., 15th May, 1902 to 30th June, 1903; headmaster, Richmond schl., 1st Oct., 1902; inspr. of schls., 1st July, 1903.

DUMARESQ, ROBT. HARE FITZROY.—Ed. at Haileybury Coll., 1885-1890; matric., New Coll., Oxford, 1890; farming in New Zealand, 1892-99; served in S. African war, 1899-1902 (Queen's medal and two clasps, King's medal and two clasps); inspr., land settmt., O.R.C., 1902-1906; sec., dept. of agric., O.R.C., 17th Apr., 1906.

DUNBAR, ARTHUR DUNCAN, M.A. (Aberdeen).—Served during S. African war in S. African Light Horse (Queen's and King's medals and clasp); clk. to dir. of educn., Transvaal and O.R.C., 1902-3; priv. sec. to educn. adviser to high comntr. for S. Africa, 1904-5; clk., educn. dept., O.R.C., 1905.

DUNCAN, ANDREW, H. F. (late lieut. R.N.).—Joined R.N., July, 1868; served in Mediterranean, S. America, Cape, India, Australia, and W. Coast of Africa; resig. Nov., 1883; passed exam. in theoretical survey, July, 1883, and practical survey, 1884, at the Cape Univ., in honours (first of his year on both occasions); from Apr., 1884, employed by the survr.-gen. of the Cape, and in priv. practice; mem. land comsnt. of Br. Bechuana land, Sept., 1885; survr.-gen. of that com., July, 1886; survr.-gen. to Br. S. Africa Co., 1891.

DUNCAN, PATRICK, C.M.G. (1904).—B. 1870; ed. at Oxford, school, Ball Coll.; 1st cls. class. mod., 1891; 1st cls. final class. school, 1893; Craven scholarship, 1890; clk., after compet. exam., int. rev., 1894; priv. sec. to Sir A. Milner; priv.
CLK., 1898; treas., Transvaal, 1901; col. sec., 1st Dec., 1903; mem. exec. and legis. couns.; mem. I.C.C.; ag. lieut.-gov., Oct., 1906.

DUNCOMBE, Henry Feversham.—Entd. col. serv. as an acctnt., treasy., Bahamas, 1891; ag. mag. and collr. in various dists., 1894-5-6; res. mag., Abaco, 1897; dist. commr., Lagos, 1898; has acted on various occasions as pol. mag., collr. of cust., and treas.; passed govt. exam. in Yoruba language, 1900.

DUNCOMBE, W. KELNALL.—B. 1878; 2nd clk., tel. dept., Bahamas, Dec., 1895; rev. offr., Inagua, Mar., 1897; asst. res. just., Watlings Island, May, 1900; res. just., Cat Island, July, 1900; supervisor of cust., Lagos, Jan., 1905; ag. collr. of cust. from Aug. to Nov., 1906, and from Apr. to May, 1907.

DUNDAS, Kenneth Robert.—Ed. in Germany, studied engnring in Norway; asst. collr. E. Africa Prot., 6th May, 1904.

DUNEDIN, 2ND BISHOP OF (founded 1864), Rt. Rev. Samuel Tarrant Nevill, D.D.—B. 1837; consec. 1871; Magdal. Coll., Camb., B.A. 1865; curate of Scarisbrick, Lancs., 1860-64; rector of Skelton, Staffs., 1864-71; is also primate of New Zealand.

DUNLOP, J. M. M., B.A., LL.D., D.C.L.—Ed. at Trin. Coll., Dublin; barrister-at-law, King's Inns, Dublin, and Inner Temple; dist. commr., Lagos, 1900; ag. pol. mag. 1901-2-3; ag. atty.-gen., 1904; ag. ch. asst. col. sec., 1905; ag. atty.-gen., 1906; ditto S. Nigeria, 1906; ag. judge of sup. ct., S. Nigeria, 1906; ag. atty.-gen., 1907; ag. pnme judge, 1907 and 1908.

DUNLOP, Colonel Samuel, R.A., C.M.G. (1884)—B. 1888; ag. commr. of pol., S. Stintins, Nov., 1870; ag. pol. mag. and commr. of ct. of requests, P.W., Apr., 1871; ag. dep. commr. of pol. and coroner, Apr., 1871; ag. dep. commr. of pol., Singapore, fire commr. and coroner, Aug., 1871; ag. inspr.-gen. of pol., Dec., 1872; commr. to Perak, Jan., 1874. In Nov., 1874, commr. with the forces sent to quell the disturbances in the native state of Sungei Ujong; inspr.-gen., Straits pol., May, 1875. In Nov., 1875, on the murder of Mr. Birch, apptd. special commr. (temporarily) for Perak affairs; organised the expedit. which captured the Passir Salak stockades, and was present at the capture, Nov., 1875; commr. to forces during operations in Perak, Dec., 1875; accompanied Gen. Colborne's force up the Perak river, and across country to Kinta; ag. res. coun., Penang, 1884 to 1885; pres. of Singapore mun. couns., 1889; ret., 1890.

DUNN, Edward John, F.G.S.—B. 1844; dir. of geological survey of Victoria, Sept., 1904; awarded Murchison medal by R. Geological Soc'y, for scientific services in S. Africa and Australia, 1905.

DUNN, Robert Ernst.—Clerk and interp. to the R.M., Umgent div., Natal, 1880; to R.M., Lions River, Mar., 1883; to R.M., Alfred, Oct., 1887; to R.M., Upper Umkomanzi, 1894; mag. for Colony, mag., Weenen div., 1901.

DUNN, Stephen Troyte, F.L.S.—B. 1868; ed. Radley and Merton Coll., Oxford (B.A., 1889); asst. for India, Kew Gdns., 1899; sup., bot. and forestry dept., Hong Kong, 1903; J.T., 1906.

DUNRAVEN AND MOUNT-EARL (4th Earl of), Windham Thomas Winwood-Quin, K.P.—B. 1841; partly, under-sec. of state for the cols., June, 1885, to Feb., 1886, and again Aug., 1886, to Feb., 1887.

DUNSMUIR, James.—B. 1851; elec. to legislature of B. Columbia, 1898; premier, 1900 to 1902, when he resig.; lieut.-gov. of B. Columbia, 1st May, 1906.

DUNSTAN, Wyndham Rowland.—M.A. (Oxon.); LL.D. (Aberdeen); F.R.S.; B. Medifor. schl.; lec. and demonstr. of chem., Oxford, 1884-86; prof. of chem., Pharm. Soc., 1886-90; lec. on chem., St. Thomas' Hosp., 1892-1900; sec. chem. soc., 1903-5; vice-pres., 1903-5; pres. section of chem. and agric. science, Brit. Ass., 1906; mem. of coun., Royal Soc., 1904-7; mem. comm'l. intell. comttee., Bd. of T., 1900-6; dir. scientific and tech. dept., Impl. Inst., 1896-96; dir., Impl. Inst., since 1903; reported on agric. resources of Cyprus for C.O. in 1904, and of Asia Minor in 1907, (reports presented to parlmt.), arranged and supervised govt. med. surveys in Ceylon, N. and S. Nigeria and Nyassaland, (represented to parlmt.); author of numerous scientific papers in the Phil. Trans. and Proceedings of Royal Soc., chem. soc., etc., and of tech. reports relating to the utilisation of the resources of the colonies, including "Cotton Cultivation in the Brit. Empire and in Egypt," 1904; "Brit. Cotton Cultivation," 1908; edited "Tech. Reps. and Scientific Papers," Impl. Inst., 1903.

DUPIGNY, E. G. Monson.—Asst. gov't. Dominica, Feb., 1889; clk. commr. of vars., 1890; clk. mag., dist. F., 1890; do., prefet., Dom., 1890-92; do. regtr.'s off., 1892; do. to Antigua, 1896; stud. Mid. Temp., 1900.

DURMAN, F. J.—B. 1882; apptd. adm. coll. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civil service and assigned to C.O., 15th April, 1901.

DU TOIT, Pieter Johannes.—Clk. dept. agric., Jan., 1890; 2nd cls. clk., May, 1890; 1st clk., June, 1900; ag. chief clk. to ag. dir. of agric., Aug., 1905; apptd. confirmed, July, 1906; under-sec. for agric., Mar., 1908.

DU VERGE, Louis Sédir Rathier, 1890 (1903).—Inspr. of distilleries, Mauritius, 1880; supt., inland rev., 1876; ag. curator of estates, 1883-4; acctnt. in bankruptcy, 1885; clk., audit, 1890; asst. rec-gen., 1895; ag. rec-gen., 1893 and 1896; storekeeper-gen., 1897; rec-gen., 1901-2, 1903-4, and in 1907; coll. cuet., Feb., 1907.

DUVIVIER, Aimé.—Clk., archives off. Mauritius, 1st Nov., 1879; custodian of arch., 1st Jan., 1891.

DYER, James Harold.—Ed. King Will's Coll., I. of Man, King Edward VI. schl., Southampton; recd. his comm., in 3rd Batt. S. L. regmt., 1889; obtained his comp'y., 1889; res. comm., 1894; joined Matabele relief force, and served through the campaign till the force was disbanded in 1897; joined C.M.R., 1897; served through siege of Mafeking; resg. Police in July, 1901; received medals and clasps; apptd. asst. dist. commr., S. Nigeria, 28th Feb., 1901; ag. dist. commr., Ediba, 1902.

DYER, Thos. Theodoric Rodney.—B. 1879; entd. pub. ser. of St. Vincent as cust. offr., 1890; ag. clk., treasy., 1891; asst. clk., P.O.; clk. gov. off., to Apr., 1892; ag. 2nd clk. in gov't., Windward Isds., May, 1892; transf. to Lucia; 4th clk., treasy., May, 1892; 3rd clk., 1893; ag. 2nd clk., Feb. to May, 1893; 2nd clk. offr., May, 1893; also supt. of govt. printing, 2nd clk. in off. of adminstr., Wind. Isds., hurricane relic offr., St. Vincent, Sept. to 1898; ag. ch. clk. and clk. of couns., St. Lucia, Oct., 1900, to Mar., 1901; apptd. clk. gov. Windward Is. (Grenada), 1st Apr., 1901; elk., col. sec's office, and elk. of ex. and leg.
16th Nov., 1901; ag. pol. mag., N. dist.; asst. treas., Carriacou; chmn., road bd., local health authority and water authority, Carriacou, and pol. mag., dist. III., St. Vincent, Feb. to May, 1904; ag. ch. clk. and clk. of couns.; sec., hurricane loan bd.; keeper of telephone stores and med. regis., St. Vincent, May to Aug., 1904; offl. trustee, Grenada, for emigrants who desire to deposit earnings in sav. bank.

DYER, Sir William T. Thiselton, M.A., F.R.S., K.C.M.G. (1899), C.M.G. (1882).—B. 1843; Chr. Ch., Oxon, 1873; asst. dir., Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, 1873; dir., 1885; ret., 1905; botan. adviser to S. of S. for Col.

DYETT, Edward Farley.—B. 1860; 2nd treasy. offr., Montserrat, Aug., 1886; ad. measurer of vessels, 1889; 1st treasy. offr., June, 1891; consnr. oaths, Nov., 1895; clk. of waterworks consnr., 1896; sec. bd. of health, Jan., 1897; held a consnr., Dec., 1897, to act as treas. of Montserrat in absence of consnr., and so acted on numerous occasions until Jan., 1900, when authorised by law to perform duties of treas. in conjunction with those of 1st treasy. offr.; J.P., May, 1898; offl. rec. in bankruptcy, Aug., 1898; holds consnr., dated Feb., 1899, to admin. oaths of office to ag. consnr. in absence of consnr. and govnr.; mem. legis. comm., Mar., 1900; visiting just. of prison, Nov., 1900; ag. col. postmr., Antigua, Nov., 1903; provsnl. M.E.C., 10th Nov., 1906; asst. treas., 1st Apr., 1907.

DYETT, Henry.—Supernumerary, P.O. and treasy., Montserrat, Leeward Is., Mar., 1894, to Feb., 1896; clk. to consnr., for assessing taxable value of real estate, 1895 and 1904; consnr.'s and mag. clk. and clk. of exec. comm., Feb., 1896; ag. 2nd treasy. offr., Apr., May and Sept., 1897; clk., legis. comm., Mar., 1898; ag. 2nd treasy. and quarantine offr., July, 1902, to Apr., 1903; ag. jun. audit clk., Antigua, Oct.-Nov., 1903; govnr. offr. and ex-officio rev. and excise offr. and clk. to N. dist. waterworks consnr., St. Kitts, Nov., 1906; sanitary inspr., Jan., 1907.

DYETT, Richard Henry Kortright.—B. 1862; served in pres. s' office, Virgin Is., 1879 to 1881, and 1882 to 1884; clk., regis.'s office, Nevis, 1886; 2nd clk., regis.'s office, Antigua, 1887; clk. to trustees, aspt. ct. lib., July, 1888; consnr. to admstr. oaths, 1889; marshal V.A. ct., L.I., Dec., 1889; clk. to mag. dist. A., 1890; dep. cor., dist. A., 1892; ag. postmr., May to Sept., 1894; 1st clk. regis.'s off., Jan., 1895; dep. cor., dist. B., Oct., 1896; ag. mag., dist. A., Jan., Feb., Apr. to Nov., 1897; sec. to H.M. Diamond Jubilee comtee., June, 1897; ag. mag., dist. B., Apr., 1898, to Jan., 1899; ag. mag., dist.
